Description: Summons "Astral Express" to smash enemies and leaves a "Light Rail" **enhancing ally squad members**.

The "Stellaron Hunter" with **the most equipment** becomes the "Star Hunter" and gains enhancement.
"Stellaron Hunters" will assist them in battle.

Stack "Cake Cats" based on the **star ratings** of "Cosmic Scholars" and obtains **resource rewards** after combat based on the number of stacks.
It is recommended to prioritize increasing the star ratings of "Cosmic Scholars."
Summons the "Engine of Creation," which will attack enemies and cause the "Belobog" character with the highest DMG to **immediately take action**.
Summons the "Lightning-Lord," which attacks based on the "Xianzhou" characters' **Hits Per Action** and grants buffs to the "Xianzhou" squad members.

Summons the **upgradable** "Borisin," which gains Experience after every battle.
The **more equipment** the squad has, the **more Experience** the "Borisin" gains.
Placing a "Galaxy Ranger" **off-field** will grant a powerful buff to the "Galaxy Ranger" **on-field**.

The "Planet of Festivities" is a **Support Bond**.
**Select one character** to become the "Giant Star," granting our squad its **unique bonus**.
Obtains **exclusive** **Day Equipment** for "Day Demigod."

Accumulate "Moonlight Essence" through combat, and upon reaching a certain amount of it, **obtains a reward**.
A **Perfect Win** grants more "Moonlight Essence."
The "Follow-Up ATK" squad members increase their DMG with **consecutive actions**, and after a certain number of times, they can launch a **"Unified Attack"**.

**Reduces** the enemy's **initial Toughness** and Toughness recovery.
After Weakness Breaking a certain number of enemies, triggers "Shockwave," Breaks all enemies Weakness, and increases the DMG they take.
Generates 2 "Borrowed Force" on the field that do not occupy a space. They **transfer** the **DMG** they receive to other enemies.
Generates "Energy Tiles" that provides Energy regeneration and DMG Amplification for the ally character on it.
"Bloodflame Arena" records the **HP loss** from "Bloodflame" members and provides buffs and attacks enemies based on the recorded value.
The "Debuff" team members apply "Afterburn" while **applying a debuff**, causing the enemy to additionally take **True DMG**.
When enemies take action or when they are defeated, triggers "Super Excitation" and deals random **DoT** effects.
After ally squad uses **Skill Points**, **draw a bonus** and gains DMG Boost and various buffs.
**Recruit chimeras** to the "Beast Garden," and they can provide buffs to the squad. In combat, the recruited chimeras will form a squad to attack enemies and deal DMG.

After each combat phase, accumulate **"Trailblaze Power"** to **purchase** characters and items in the "Trailblaze Store." As your Bond level increases, the "Trailblaze Store" will unlock even rarer goods!

Each **3-star** "Astropolis Merchant Guild" character on the field **activates** 1 level of the **Bond Privilege effect**.
Upon reaching the **Level 6** Privilege effect, your Store will **sell characters with a high star rating at their original price**!

Summons "Quintet Joint" to attack all enemies, and increases the ally squad's **DMG Amplification** after the attack. After a "High-Cloud Quintet" member takes action, advances "Quintet Joint's" action.
**Select 2** "Intertwined Dreamscapes" characters. After they take action a set number of times, **"Dance of Two"** is triggered, and they launch a simultaneous attack.
After an enemy takes DMG, accumulate "KO Value" to trigger **Execution**.
In combat, creates a "Soul" that can **transfer DMG** for the enemy with the highest Max HP.
The on-field "Counter" character with the most equipment becomes the **"Counter King"**: More likely to be attacked and deals "Counter DMG." "Counter" members can "Provoke" enemy targets.

"Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae" will summon a "Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae" of the same star rating in the off-field area.
After taking action, "Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae"/"Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae" Charges "Twin Dragons' Call." When fully charged, they launch a combined attack against enemies and provide Shields.
Clara can perform an **enhanced modification** on Svarog, providing a variety of powerful effects.

You can **continuously drag** a character to Phainon to absorb Coreflame and convert it into "Torchflame," providing buffs to this unit or the squad. A **Chrysos Heir** can convert more.
When a "Flame Reaver" appears in combat, it can steal **Max Challenge progress**. When the progress reaches its limit, activates "Apocalypse" and wins the battle.

**Obtain** Aeon ★ Aha to accumulate "Phantasmoon Power" and **increase THEIR cost**. Drawing on the **total star rating** of "Phantasmoon Games" or "Elation" characters, Aha reclaims THEIR rightful Aeonic powers and ascends into a 7-cost Aeon of Elation!
